basic_details.job_title: NLUO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Assistant Registrar, Section Officer Posts

age_limit.details: Assistant Registrar and Section Officer: Maximum age 65 years. No minimum age limit specified.

qualification.education_qualification: Retired Employees who have held positions in specific Pay Levels of Government of Odisha
qualification.details: Assistant Registrar: Retired Employees of Government of Odisha / Government of India / Reputed Autonomous Institutions, held a post in Pay Level 11, 12, 13 or 14 of Government of Odisha at the time of retirement. Section Officer: Retired Employees of Government of Odisha / Government of India / Reputed Autonomous Institutions, held a post in Pay Level 7, 8, 9 or 10 of Government of Odisha at the time of retirement.

salary_details.assistant registrar (contractual): Consolidated Pay of Rs. 35,000/- or adopting pay minus pension scheme
salary_details.section officer (contractual): Consolidated Pay of Rs. 20,000/- or adopting pay minus pension scheme

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NLUO Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NLUO to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NLUO Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NLUO to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Law University Odisha (NLUO) for filling contractual positions in Cuttack, Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NLUO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are available for the positions of Assistant Registrar and Section Officer on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NLUO posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and complete the submission process is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be retired employees who have held specific positions in Pay Levels of the Government of Odisha, Government of India, or reputed autonomous institutions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NLUO Assistant Registrar and Section Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for these posts should not exceed 65 years of age as per the official recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Registrar post will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 35,000/- or opt for the pay minus pension scheme.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Section Officer post will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 20,000/- or opt for the pay minus pension scheme.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for NLUO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online by filling out the Google Form available on the university's career page and sending the physical copy with documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises short-listing of eligible candidates followed by an interview conducted by the university authorities.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can visit the official National Law University Odisha website at www.nluo.ac.in to access the application link and official notification details.
